FN-PS19SER-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 353
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/18/2025
House Bill 353 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Office of Prosecution
Services, funded by the State General Fund, by an estimated $331,000 annually by setting the
salary of district attorneys (DAs) newly appointed or elected after October 1, 2021 to equal the
salary of an incoming circuit court judge. These obligations would be effective beginning in
either fiscal year 2029, or, if the constitutional amendment proposed by Senate Bill 226 is
ratified, in fiscal year 2026.
This bill would also provide for DAs to receive cost-of-living adjustments (COLAs) during their
term of office, contingent on the ratification of the constitutional amendment proposed by
Senate Bill 226, which would further increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an
undetermined amount dependent on the amount of any such increases passed by the Legislature
subsequent to passage of this bill.
In addition, this bill codifies the current practice of the Alabama Administrative Office of the
Courts of adjusting the salaries for justices and judges to include on any COLAs provided by the
Legislature.
Finally, this bill provides that beginning with the next term of office after October 1, 2025, the
compensation of any elected official subject to a local law that sets their compensation, in whole
or in part, on the salary of a circuit or district court judge shall be calculated using the salaries
amount adjusted by this bill and that any adjustment based on longevity must be based on the
respective elected official's time in office.

FN-PS19SER-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 353
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/24/2025
House Bill 353 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation General Fund would
allow district attorneys (DAs) to receive a cost-of-living adjustment (COLAs) during their term
of office reflective of all COLAs enacted on or after October 1, 2021, contingent on the
ratification of the constitutional amendment proposed by House Bill 354. This would increase
the obligations of the State General Fund by an Office of Prosecution Services estimated
$176,021 in fiscal year 2026 and an estimated $528,064 in fiscal year 2027 and each fiscal year
thereafter.
This bill would also provide that the base salary for DAs elected or appointed after October 1,
2025 would be adjusted to reflect any COLA enacted by the Legislature on or after October 1,
2021.
In addition, this bill codifies the current practice of the Alabama Administrative Office of the
Courts of adjusting the salaries for justices and judges to include any COLAs provided by the
Legislature.
Finally, this bill provides that beginning with the next term of office beginning after October 1,
2025, the compensation of any elected official subject to a local law that sets their
compensation, in whole or in part, on the salary of a circuit or district court judge shall be
calculated using the salary amounts adjusted by this bill and that any adjustment based on
longevity must be based on the respective elected official's time in office.
